title: HealthInformatics EDTriageModelLaunch

stats.done_summary: Completed the evaluation of TriageAssist-B vs TriageAssist-A. Analyzed offline and online metrics, generated visualizations, and wrote a comprehensive report in report/report.md detailing the methodology, results, and discussion. The recommendation is to not expand TriageAssist-B due to significant increases in clinician overrides, LWBS rates, and unscheduled returns, likely caused by over-triage and poor calibration.
